note: All four states are computed in Python by the pipeline's own filter_signal and normalize_signal, then strided (never averaged) to the point budget. The browser draws them; it does not produce them.

records.title: PhysioNet 2016 — normal
records.note: The reference record used by the inference gate, so the waveform on this page and the probability in tests/test_inference.py come from the same bytes.

records.title: PhysioNet 2016 — abnormal
records.note: Adult PhysioNet recording at 2 kHz, the corpus the binary model is fitted on.

records.title: PASCAL set A — 44.1 kHz
records.note: Recorded at 44.1 kHz on a phone microphone. Resampling to the working rate is the largest single change the pipeline makes to this corpus.

records.title: PASCAL set B — 4 kHz
records.note: PASCAL set B recordings are short; several are under a second, which is why the duration bound in the inference validator exists.
